data.name: Allelon
data.detailed_description:
GAMEPLAY

Allelon is a third-person semi-realistic investigative stealth robot game following two main characters, Ollie and Spade. As Ollie, sneak around the city, evading enemies as they track you down to stop your mission. As Spade, collect and connect the evidence as you work through your assigned case.

THE STORY

Allelon is set in a futuristic city, Andropolis, where people are long gone, and human consciousness has been transferred into robot bodies to preserve life. 

Spade is a high-profile robot detective for the city of Andropolis, solving cases for decades with the help of his live-in AI assistant, Irene. When assigned to a murder case connected to a major insurrectionist group, Telos, he follows the footsteps of a rebel through the city, attempting to figure out how he died, and what he died for.

Ollie is a robot rebel, attempting to expose a government ploy to the general public. With the help of his partner Claude, he sneaks through the city and avoids government officials tracking him down, all in search of a hard drive containing all of the information he needs to change Andropolis forever.

FEATURES

  • Two Playable Characters

  • Stealth-Based Progression

  • Investigative Progression

  • Minigames

  • Narrated Dialogue
